# Nachiket Galande — Senior Full Stack Developer

> Personal portfolio of Nachiket Galande, a Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications.

## About

Nachiket Galande is a Senior Full Stack Developer (Senior Analyst) at Accenture, based in Mumbai, India. He specialises in system architecture, database design, performance optimisation, and translating complex requirements into efficient solutions.

## Skills

- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, Redux, Zustand, Tailwind CSS, Material UI
- **Backend**: Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, FastAPI, Flask, GraphQL, Fastify
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Azure SQL, PL/SQL
- **Cloud**: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud (OCI/OIC)
- **Tools**: Docker, Git, Jest, Postman
- **Languages**: Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript
